content.short: DRPC is a backup RPC provider with a pay-for-use model and a network of independent third-party partners and public nodes.
content.description: DRPC is a backup RPC provider for EVM-compatible networks. It runs a distributed network of independent third-party partners and public nodes designed to deliver low latency, scalable capacity, and resistance to censorship. You can use public endpoints or sign up in seconds to create unlimited endpoints and view detailed statistics about your RPC requests, helping teams monitor throughput, latency, error rates, and reliability across multiple chains in real time.
content.meta: DRPC provides backup RPC services for EVM-compatible networks. Discover DRPC and other Infrastructure Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
